summary: Restores the JaCoCo XML report on the aggregate jacocoReport task and adds per-job Codecov upload plus a manual-trigger finalization job to the PR workflow, committing the public Codecov upload token as a fork fallback.

tests.evidence: No product code changes; the build/CI change is verified by the CI run itself (Codecov comment shows coverage arriving).

user_docs.evidence: TESTING.md gains a Code coverage section; its claims (jacocoReport task name enables instrumentation, -Pcoverage) match build-logic.java.gradle.kts:50 and build-parameters.

doc_comments.evidence: Workflow and matrix.mjs comments are accurate; the new build.gradle.kts comment still points only to omni.yml as the XML consumer although main.yml now uploads it too (minor).

change_description.evidence: Build/CI-only change with no user-visible behaviour, so no changelog entry owed; description explains why, what, and the token trade-off.

performance.evidence: Coverage instrumentation slows CI jobs and crashed Windows workers; addressed in-PR by limiting collectCoverage to ubuntu rows.

security.evidence: Commits the Codecov upload token in main.yml and exposes secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN as a job env var for if-gating; credential handling mandates a focused check even though the description argues the token is low-sensitivity.

backward_compat.evidence: No public API, default, or runtime behaviour changes.

concurrency.evidence: No shared state or resource lifecycle in product code.

error_model.evidence: No error paths or messages changed.

correctness.evidence: The step if-conditions (!cancelled(), steps.test.outcome, repository/token gate) are small but easy to get wrong; one was already fixed in-PR (commit 3ed0b449cf).

user_value.evidence: Internal CI/coverage plumbing, no user-facing feature.

contradictions.evidence: codecov.yml switches to manual_trigger: true, but omni.yml (base :374) still uploads coverage and never calls send-notifications, so its scheduled/dispatch uploads will never be notified; the new build.gradle.kts comment also names only omni.yml as the consumer.

build_ci.evidence: Changes main.yml, matrix.mjs, codecov.yml, and Gradle report config; omni.yml is left inconsistent with the new manual_trigger (and still uses the deprecated `file:` input with a mislabeled '# v6' pin).

observability.evidence: No logging or metrics in product code.

plan.why: A cohesive CI/build change; one reviewer can cover the token handling and workflow consistency together.
